model_type: Gemini Dual-Sided Neutral Market Impact Agent
training_method: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompt-based few-shot inference with structured JSON schema (responseJsonSchema) enforcing forced symmetrical dual-impact extraction, economic transmission mechanism modeling, and anti-inducement regulatory compliance.
simulated_review_policy: Full symmetrical analysis with zero directional advisory steering. Preserves both positive and negative financial market consequences.

confidence_policy.review_required_flag: Set review_required=true when confidence < 0.80 or neutrality_score < 0.85 or forbidden advisory words detected
